summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation and stock reservation system.

requirements.description: Reserve all lines of an order together atomically, aggregating repeated SKUs, or reserve nothing if stock is insufficient or unknown.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: A warehouse inventory stock and an order containing multiple lines including repeated SKUs
acceptance.then: All lines are aggregated and subtracted atomically from stock if sufficient, or no stock is consumed if any SKU is insufficient or unknown

requirements.description: Expedited orders must be allocated inventory before normal orders, preserving the original arrival order within each priority level.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A list of orders with both expedited and normal priority levels competing for available stock
acceptance.when: Orders are fulfilled against warehouse stock
acceptance.then: All valid expedited orders are processed before normal orders in arrival order, receiving priority stock allocation

requirements.description: Order IDs must be idempotent: only the first occurrence of an order ID is processed, and any subsequent occurrences with the same ID are completely ignored.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: A list of orders containing duplicate occurrences of order IDs
acceptance.then: Only the first occurrence of each unique order ID is processed or claimed, and subsequent occurrences are ignored

requirements.description: Invalid order lines and orders must be rejected without mutating stock, and caller inputs must never be modified.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Stock and orders inputs that may contain invalid order lines or invalid orders
acceptance.when: Fulfillment and reservation functions are invoked
acceptance.then: Invalid orders and lines are rejected with appropriate failure reasons without consuming stock or mutating input objects

assumptions: Stock values must be nonnegative safe integers and stock keys must be nonempty strings.
Orders are processed in batches where priority ordering takes precedence over arrival ordering across priorities.
Caller inputs including stock, orders, and nested objects are treated as immutable.
